- Decision timeline: procurement kickoff early March, commercial decision expected by mid-April.
- Key decision criteria called out on the call: compliance posture (SOC 2 Type II), pentest results, data residency/retention, P95 latency targets (~<200ms for inference at pilot load), and unit economics.

- Economic buyer / budget owner: Tom Alvarez (VP Product)
- Security / infosec reviewer: Laura Chen (Director Security)
- Procurement & legal: procurement@rivertonhealth.com, Sara Patel (procurement lead) per Tom

Requested evidence / asks from your side: SOC 2 report (summary + availability of full report under NDA), public pentest summary, sample audit logs (redacted), data retention policy answers, and brief performance profile for inference at expected sequence lengths.

Attached: Riverton_Security_Questionnaire_20260222.pdf (your security team asked us to fill this on the call; I’ve attached our initial responses).

Proposed next steps:
1) We will gather SOC2 & pen-test materials and upload to the shared Drive by next week (internal owners below).
2) Schedule an evidence-review + procurement-readout on March 5 — 30 minutes (confirm time).
3) We’ll prepare a short commercial term summary for procurement to accelerate the redline phase.

Owners (Redwood):
- SOC2 + pentest ownership: Monica Patel (security)
- Audit logs + retention answers: Neha Kapoor (Product Ops / Compliance)
- Pilot coordination + scheduling: me (Tessa) and Marcus for success plan

Please flag missing stakeholders or correction to the timeline. If procurement needs an official quote or SOW ahead of the March 5 meeting, let us know and we’ll prioritize.
